title: AI 研究与应用的多维度进展
core_insight: 今日新增的 AI 信息显示，技术层面上有多项研究成果，基础设施层面上有新型芯片和算力趋势，应用层面上有新行业和新场景的进入，资本信号上有多项投资和收购动向，风险信号上有监管和伦理问题的讨论

dimension_texts.technology: 新型检索增强生成模型和大语言模型的提出 新的训练方法和架构创新 SIRIN: A Unified Toolkit for Detecting Contextual Hallucinations in Retrieval-Augmented and Memory-Grounded LLM Systems RAG-TESTER: Automated End-to-End Testing of Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
dimension_texts.infrastructure: 新型芯片和算力趋势的出现 云厂商的定价和供应链的变化 Anthropic is hiring an AI chip design team MacPaw taps Liquid AI to offer on-device inference to devs building for its app store
dimension_texts.application: 新行业和新场景的进入 传统解决方案的替代 MagicSchool AI leads off a series of articles featuring startup founders from non-technical backgrounds who have launched successful venture-backed companies Shopify says AI search is driving more traffic and sales, not replacing Google
dimension_texts.capital: 多项投资和收购动向 估值水平的变化 大厂战略投资和收购 Klaviyo acquires Elias Torres’ Agency in full-circle reunion for tech founders Jeff Dean and other top AI researchers are leaving Google to launch their own startup
